description: ABARES Drought Risk by Farm Profit is a dataset listed in South Australian Government data directory (data.sa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by National Recovery and Resilience Agency. This layer displays the percentage of drought risk by Farm Profit by ABARES AAGIS (Australian Agricultural and Grazing Industry Survey) regions as determined by Australian Bureau of Agricultural and Resource Economics and Science (ABARES). Coverage: South Australia. The portal files it under the publisher National Recovery and Resilience Agency. Its tags are Environment, drought, farm, risk. It offers 5 resource(s) in esri shapefile - zipped, geojson, sld, wfs, wms. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-sa.
